detail.longDescription: It is difficult to strike a balance between productivity and preventing burnout — largely because we care alot about what we do. Yet, to keep doing it, we need to develop the right approach so that our efforts remain sustainable. I share some of my own experience as a solo indie dev in the video, and want you to find your way to consistency as well. How I deal with burnout and keep working steadily https:// youtu.be/34G6C7DZubI # Productivity # IndieDev # GameDev
